name: therundown-data
title: TheRundown Data MCP
description: Official read-only MCP server for TheRundown's sports odds Product API. Six tools list sports, affiliates, markets, events, open main-line odds, and futures, plus a therundown://brief resource. Runs locally over stdio with your own API key; the same tools are hosted at https://mcp.therundown.io/mcp.

THERUNDOWN_API_KEY.description: Your TheRundown Product API key. The server sends it only in the X-TheRundown-Key header and never accepts it as a tool argument.
